designer_notes: Firecracker tutorial: two 2-wide, 2-layer bramble walls flank a 3-wide channel (columns 3-5, rows 5-8), under 3-wide one-layer shoulders on row 4 that funnel into the channel. Tutorial swap: (3,8) green <-> (3,7) yellow makes an L (column 3 rows 5-7 + row 7 columns 3-5), a Firecracker at (3,7) whose double blast fully clears the 2-layer wall brambles (2,6)-(2,8), showing why Firecrackers beat layers. Fixed (3,4) red keeps it from growing into a longer line; the walls cap row 7. Goal OB02 x22 vs plan x19 (+16%, inside +-20%); 22 of 73 playable cells = 30% blocked, 38 layer hits. Moves 26 (plan 28 -2, set by balance). [balance 2026-11-28] moves 28->26; bot still 100%, sent back. [redesign 2026-11-28] was 20 one-layer brambles (20 hits, bot 100%, 20.4 moves left); now 22 brambles (goal at the +20% limit) with all 16 wall brambles at 2 layers (38 hits, +90%), and shoulders widened to (2,4)/(6,4) so the channel is the only open way down.
